body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-03 UTC. Moderator findings on #558 (merge `7e9979545f91a8ee87bf2068667f97986ecccee3`) and #560 (merge `5a276118e757e5865a5f5d65e2040d91209bf79f`). Follow-up to completed evidence scopes #520/#521.

The new packets copy old zero-coverage/absent-footprint results into current audit descriptions:
- Nukunonu assessment.audit.ring_inventory: all 97 rows have all_location_overlap_fraction=0 and absent-footprint status; independent_gshhg_assessment says 0% currently represented.
- Bounty assessment.audit.osm_ring_inventory: all 27 rows have zero overlap and absent-footprint status; README says the existing audit finds all 27 absent from current location footprints.

But both merge snapshots' world-index includes `geography/source-restoration-additions.json`, blob `18989f4f6b2789057a00eeda6c5c7e51f06e3caf`. It contains Nukunonu ID `atlas:macro-coverage:location:a0457f0d44c94b71f00d` with 97 polygon components and Bounty ID `atlas:macro-coverage:location:73281d3672f84a47a770` with 27. Every inventory ring bbox matches a published component bbox, and the current source hashes match the packets. Thus the blanket current absence/zero-overlap assertions are stale; this does not prove shoreline completeness or geographic approval.

Bounded evidence correction: one coherent PR, maximum two if the independent packets are safer to correct separately. Owned paths are the two packet subdirectories below; coordinate any still-active original ownership before claim. Preserve original pre-restoration comparison reports; do not rewrite original source archives, shared geography, records, certificates, grid or live data.

Acceptance:
- Explicitly label archived comparison results with their actual inspected baseline/release and date; never present them as current indexed coverage.
- Recheck each subject against the assigned current release and retain current coverage results separately, with scope/hash and appropriate geographic area method.
- Correct/supersede README and machine-readable assertions consistently. Verifiers must distinguish source-integrity checks from current coverage checks.
- Preserve the genuine OSM/GSHHG/official-source disagreements, shoreline uncertainty, shared-parent questions, stable identities and all history. Existing representation does not certify complete coastlines or authorize imports.
- Coordinate separately tracked parent-count/source-pointer work; do not expand this into a worldwide audit.
